plans.admission_reason: score 79.8 >= admit threshold 72.0 with required research contract present

candidate.accessibility_delta: One GB10-class local run can tell Enoch and outside researchers which speculative-decoding branch deserves real implementation, preserving negative evidence instead of wasting local GPU time on five separate systems.
candidate.baseline_to_beat: Best static-policy DFlash b16 on Qwen/Qwen3-8B with z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16, AR target decoding mini-slice, and EAGLE-3 reference mini-slice only if already wired without blocking the harness.
candidate.description: A unified first-pass oracle harness that turns one local GB10-class DFlash trace into branch-selection evidence for speculative-decoding follow-up work. It is intended to replace five independent from-scratch projects with one instrumentation pass and a deterministic decision matrix.
candidate.hypothesis: One bounded DFlash b16 speculative-decoding trace can rank SSD-lite outcome prediction, dynamic vocabulary, entropy/acceptance control, retrieval/suffix-cache speculation, and grammar/schema-aware speculation before Enoch spends engineering time implementing any branch.
candidate.implementation: Build enoch/research/spec_trace_oracle_v0 with run_manifest.json, requests.jsonl, rounds.jsonl, candidate_sets.parquet, topk_sidecar.npz, timing_microbench.json, oracle_report.md, metrics.json, failure_cases.jsonl, and .enoch/project_decision.json. Capture top-k, entropy, margins, accept lengths, latency, candidate-vocab coverage, n-gram/suffix hits, and grammar frontier stats without storing full logits or private text. Run 384 generations (~155k max new tokens) across agentic_loop, json_tool, code_edit, math_reasoning, open_chat, and long_context prompts at temperatures 0.0 and 0.7, with AR/EAGLE-3 mini-slices optional and non-blocking.
candidate.kill_condition: Stop the whole line if no branch clears continue thresholds, best modeled end-to-end gain is below 5%, public prompt subset does not reproduce the private signal, measurement noise remains above 5% after three repeated timing passes, or instrumentation cannot produce the first oracle report within two engineering days.
likely_failure_modes: DFlash instrumentation overhead distorts the measured bottleneck
No branch clears modeled gain thresholds
Private-prompt signal fails to reproduce on public prompts
DFlash model setup consumes the engineering budget
Trace volume grows too large without full-logit safeguards
candidate.mechanism: Run Qwen3-8B with z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16, log per-round speculative decoding features and lightweight sidecars, then compute offline oracle analyses for all five candidate branches from the same trace.
candidate.novelty_comparison: This candidate supersedes the individually admitted speculative-decoding branch ideas by producing one shared DFlash trace and deterministic oracle report before branch implementation. It is not another branch; it is the branch-selection harness.

candidate.success_threshold: Whole harness succeeds if it produces a complete trace and oracle report, at least one branch clears its continue threshold, and modeled or measured gain is at least 8% for a branch without p95 regression over 5%. Branch thresholds: SSD-lite top-4 hit >=60% with draft cost >=8%; dynamic vocab coverage@2048 >=95% with LM-head >=20% and indexed head >=1.3x faster; controller oracle gain >=8% with AUC >=0.65; retrieval hit >=20% with accepted tokens per hit >=3 and lookup <=0.2 ms; grammar median frontier <=512 or <=10% vocab with invalid draft >=10% and gain >=8%.
